display.name: Datadog
display.blurb: Query Datadog during a run via the `pup` agent CLI. Both keys are brokered — injected at the egress proxy, never seen by the agent.

cli.doc: Use `pup` (the official Datadog CLI for agents) to query Datadog from this session — logs, metrics, monitors, dashboards, and more (200+ commands across 33+ products). Authentication is automatic: `DD_API_KEY` and `DD_APP_KEY` are managed placeholders the egress proxy replaces with the real keys on requests to api.datadoghq.com. Do NOT run `pup auth login` or set real keys. This profile grants read access (GET) to the Datadog API; run `pup --help` to explore commands.
